title: Totals tie to Sales by Customer to the cent
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts', 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $121.50 by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for customer B, with a part in category A, cost $40.00, priced $54.00 by Default, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick customers A and B in the Customer filter.
  3. Open Reports › Sales By Customer.
  4. Pick customers A and B in the Customer filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens on this month at your location.

Step 2:

  • Totals read Parts Invoiced $175.50 (customer A's work order 1, $121.50 by tier A, + customer B's Part Sale 1, $54.00) and Parts Cost $140.00 ($100.00 + $40.00), Parts Margin $35.50.

Step 3:

  • Sales By Customer opens on this month at the same location.

Step 4:

  • Sales By Customer's Totals read Parts Invoiced $175.50: $175.50 − $175.50 = $0.00.
  • Its Parts Margin reads $35.50, matching Sales by Tier (so Parts Cost matches too).
